name: Mana Community - Emergency Flash Broadcast Sanitizer & Action Generator

parameters.jsCode:
const item = $input.first().json.body || $input.first().json;
const prompt = "You are an AI crisis communications coordinator for Mana Community emergency operations.
You convert urgent incident reports (power outage, lift entrapment, pipeline burst) into calm, clear, panic-free flash broadcasts with DOs & DON'Ts and resolution timelines.
Analyze the input payload:
__DATA__

Respond strictly with valid JSON conforming to this schema:
{
  "severityLevel": "HIGH",
  "urgencyClassification": "SERVICE_DISRUPTION",
  "emergencyHeadline": "Water Supply Interruption - Block B & C (Repair In Progress)",
  "sanitizedBroadcastMessage": "A temporary water pressure drop has occurred due to pump valve gasket maintenance. DG-backed auxiliary pump is being engaged.",
  "actionableDos": [
    "Keep kitchen and bathroom taps turned off to prevent air locks",
    "Collect RO drinking water from Ground Floor community station"
  ],
  "actionableDonts": [
    "Do not run high-volume washing machines until pressure stabilizes",
    "Avoid calling emergency security line for general water status"
  ],
  "expectedResolutionEtaMinutes": 45,
  "escalationHelpline": "+91-98800-MANA-HELP",
  "auditTimestamp": "2026-11-21T08:30:00Z"
}";
return [{ json: { prompt: prompt.replace("__DATA__", JSON.stringify(item, null, 2)), originalInput: item } }];
